sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Consumer Defensive holds sustained top-tier strength, while bond proxies Real Estate and Utilities surge and cyclicals like Basic Materials and Technology deteriorate.

Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors are commanding market leadership. Consumer Defensive stands out as the anchor of stability, backed by strong momentum and sustained top-tier performance alongside Healthcare. Meanwhile, Real Estate and Utilities are aggressively rotating upward in the 5-day rankings, pushing momentum scores higher across traditional safety groups.

In contrast, cyclical and growth pockets are fading. Basic Materials suffered the steepest weekly rank decline, joined by slippage in Financials and Technology. Broad market participation remains absent, underscored by zero sectors maintaining an all-green posture across all measured timeframes.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** 0 of 11 sectors qualify as all-green across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD frames.
- **Consumer Defensive Durability:** Holds sustained strong leadership across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, pairing a rank 2 standing with an elite 0.950 momentum score.
- **Top-Tier Stability:** Energy (rank 1, momentum 0.633) and Healthcare (rank 3, momentum 0.800) maintain the highest overall ranks alongside Consumer Defensive.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Defensive Surges:** Real Estate gained +3 spots over the last 5 sessions to reach rank 4 (0.667 momentum), while Utilities advanced +2 spots to rank 7 (0.583 momentum).
- **Steepest Slips:** Basic Materials dropped -3 spots over 5 sessions to rank 9 (0.217 momentum); Financials (-1 spot to rank 6, 0.57 momentum) and Technology (-1 spot to rank 5, 0.183 momentum) also retreated.
- **Laggards Bottleneck:** Communication Services anchors the bottom at rank 11 with the market's lowest momentum score of 0.117.

## Divergences
- **Technology Momentum Breakdown:** Technology maintains a mid-tier YTD position at rank 5 despite an anemic momentum score of 0.183, signaling rapid underlying deceleration.
- **Energy Rank vs. Velocity:** While Energy maintains the top YTD rank of 1, its momentum score of 0.633 trails Consumer Defensive (0.950) and Healthcare (0.800).
- **Absence of Broad Conviction:** Zero groups demonstrate positive alignment across all timeframes, highlighting persistent internal market dispersion.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth remains exceptionally narrow with just 4 of 144 groups all-green, driven by capital rotating heavily into defensive staples and insurance while metals and semiconductors suffer sharp rank collapses.

Defensive pockets are dominating industry leadership. Insurance groups, consumer staples, and discount retail are capturing market share, reinforced by sustained multi-month strength in Discount Stores and Insurance - Property & Casualty. Utilities and select consumer services are also staging rapid short-term rank improvements.

Conversely, cyclical and tech-heavy industries are fading aggressively. Metals, mining, and semiconductor complexes experienced severe 5-session drops, led by Copper (-58 spots to rank 100) and Semiconductors (-42 spots to rank 89). Energy-adjacent and commodities plays remain pinned to the bottom of broader momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 4 of 144 industries are positive across all time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD): Discount Stores (momentum 0.93), Insurance - Property & Casualty (0.88), Confectioners (0.80), and Insurance Brokers (0.80).
- **Momentum Leaders:** Discount Stores leads the market with a momentum score of 0.931 (rank 18), followed closely by Insurance - Reinsurance at 0.922 (rank 7) and Medical Distribution at 0.899 (rank 15).
- **Sustained Performers:** Groups holding top-36 ranks across 1, 3, and 6 months include Discount Stores, Insurance - Reinsurance, Medical Distribution, Insurance - Property & Casualty, Lodging, Beverages - Non-Alcoholic, Security & Protection Services, and Household & Personal Products.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Gainers:** Insurance - Property & Casualty climbed 25 spots to rank 27 (momentum 0.88), followed by Insurance Brokers (+24 to rank 63), Shell Companies (+22 to rank 70), and Confectioners (+21 to rank 24).
- **Severe Decliners:** Copper plummeted 58 spots to rank 100 (momentum 0.19), Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries fell 49 spots to rank 92, and Semiconductors dropped 42 spots to rank 89 (momentum 0.16).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Uranium (0.016, rank 142), Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.029, rank 141), Solar (0.034, rank 143), and Gambling (0.076, rank 144) remain the weakest groups in the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading Leadership:** Several groups maintain elevated momentum but are deteriorating in near-term rank, including Medical Care Facilities (momentum 0.71, rank -3 over 5 days), Industrial Distribution (momentum 0.65, rank -8), and Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.65, rank -6).
- **Emerging Upward Moves:** Early short-term improvement is appearing in lower-momentum groups, led by Apparel Retail (+9 spots, momentum 0.52), Utilities - Diversified (+9 spots, momentum 0.46), and REIT - Diversified (+8 spots, momentum 0.45).
